full_judgment: In cross examination he stated that before recording of the statement he did not administer any oath to the witnesses as there is no such provision. There is no mention who, produce these 3 witnesses before him but it has been mentioned in the order that I.O. of the case produced them before him. In the statement of these 3 witnesses it has not been stated before the signature that the statements were read over to them and they having found them to be correct put their signatures. Thereafter on this matter he put his signature. The signature of Shamsul Islam and the certificate of him is close to each other. It has not been written is the statement from where he written the statements of the witnesses. Generally this type of statement recorded at the private chamber (Khas karma). It has not been mentioned in the statement that which one of the statement started recording when and when it was completed. It has also not been mentioned to whom these witnesses were handed over. It is not true that at the time of taking signature of witnesses informant and _ investigating officer were present. It is not true that as per direction of the informant and investigating officer after writing the statements and on putting the witnesses in fear extracted their signatures.
